name: Across Kiloparsecs
source:
The accidental death of a good friend has left you stunned.

As you begin to come to terms with this new reality, you find hints that maybe it wasn't an accident after all.

Discover what really happened on your home station in this short science-fiction visual novel. Someone is hiding something, and it's up to you to find out what. Was it just an accident, or a murder? Powerful forces could be at work and you might be endangering not only your life, but the lives of your closest friends.

This is a prologue to the tactical space strategy game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644180/]"Kiloparsec Uprising"[/url].

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
好朋友的意外去世让你震惊不已。

当你开始接受这个新现实时，你会发现一些暗示，也许这根本不是一次意外。

在这部短篇科幻视觉小说中了解你的家乡到底发生了什么。有人隐瞒了一些事情，而你需要找出真相。这只是一场意外，还是一场谋杀？强大的力量可能正在发挥作用，你可能不仅会危及自己的生命，还会危及你最亲密朋友的生命。

这是战术太空策略游戏 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644180/]“Kiloparsec Uprising”[/url] 的序幕。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2505080/]Steam[/url]]
